title: Smart Loading Zone Pilot Program / Automated Enforcement / Public-Right-of-Way
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation to report back in 30 days on the implementation and outcomes of Smart Loading Zone or similar curb management programs in other municipalities. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT LADOT to report back in 30 days on the steps necessary to initiate a Smart Loading Zone pilot program in the City to improve loading zone access and short-term delivery parking. / ) (Q)//L PRESENTED BY: EUNISSES HERNAND, Councilmember, 1t Distr SECONDED BY:J (00/ OCT 2 1 2025
